messages.en: Yesterday was totally Hayeon Day!!
The things I had been looking forward to were finally revealed.
킄
You're asking why Hayoi isn't sleeping?
Practice ended and I just finished showering!!
I'm completely soft and fresh.

messages.ko: 빵투어 월욜에 갔던거야?? 그 아침일찍부터 스케줄 있다햇던거!
messages.en: Did you go on the bread tour on Monday?? The one you said you had an early morning schedule for!
That's righttttt.
Did you watch Gaedisu?
Haseok will overdo it.
It was so shocking.
My beauty?
Next time I'm going to try blowing from both sides.
I'm getting greedy.
Ah, at the filming site...
I was going to bring my recorder,
but I forgot.
I should carry two recorders around like Chaewon.
You have to do a nationwide tour.
Hayeon Cocoder Ensemble Concert.
Ticket price: 1,000 won.
Please come in large numbers~ So I can buy bungeoppang.
Seriously, filming was so much fun.
Please give me lots of shoots like this.
I'm thirsty for overdoing things..
It was sssrrsly so fun.
Sesese?
You should have your own content series like Jumansa.
I should do 'Hayeon's Comedy Class' sometime.
Bring in the people who never overdo things.
"How to let yourself go. How to throw away your ego."
I should teach things like that.
I have so much content I want to do.
My schedule for this year is already full.
Also, when I went on Gaedisu...
I got to meet Ken-sunbaenim.
I really learned something from him.

messages.ko: 이정도 무리는 쉽게 해줘야 성공할수 있구나
messages.en: I realized you have to overdo things this much if you want to succeed.
And I learned one more thing.
He said he even held a wedding ceremony with his fans.
I really have to learn from that.
**Y/n**, should we get married?
I can't go anywhere else either.
If we get married...
**Y/n**, you'll be mine forever.
**Y/n**'s opinion actually isn't important.
Where should we have the wedding?
I'm picking out a wedding dress, okay?
I'll be really pretty, right?
You want to see it, don't you?
You really shouldn't just say things like that.
I'm not just saying it.
I'm serious though.

messages.ko: 나도 연차좀 쌓이고 내 의견 낼수있을때
messages.en: Once I've built up more seniority and can speak my mind...
Let's do it right away.
Don't run away until I'm ready.
You can wait for me, right?

messages.ko: 흰색 드레스 입은 하연인 어떨까 궁금하네?🥰
messages.en: I wonder what Hayeon would look like in a white dress?🥰
Huh? I'm not wearing white though.
I'm going with purple.
With lots and lots of frills.
A fluffy dress.
And I'm going to wear a green cape.
Are you Rapunzel?
Oh, that's kind of the vibe.
Instead of the dress standing out...
I'll make the long blonde wig be the eye-catching part.

messages.ko: 그럼 나는 주황색바지에 파란 셔츠 입을래
messages.en: Then I'll wear orange pants and a blue shirt.
Is the blue shirt checkered..??
That's not it~ ~

messages.ko: 근데 너 옷 조금 탐난다 내가 뺏어 입으면 안돼?
messages.en: But I'm kind of jealous of your outfit. Can I steal it and wear it?
Should we both wear purple dresses together~?
Ah, reareally~?
Reareally~

messages.ko: 아.. 나 비주얼로 너무 밀릴 거 같은데.. 하연아 너가 좀만 더 밤티인 걸로 입어주면 안될까?
messages.en: Ah.. I feel like I'd lose too badly in the visuals.. Hayeon, couldn't you wear something a little uglier?

messages.ko: 내가 입으면 밤티옷도 좀 멋져보이긴 한데
messages.en: If I wear it, even ugly clothes end up looking kind of cool.
Can you handle that?
Seseseririously.
I'm looking forward to it~?
From now on, wherever you go...
if someone asks whether you're dating...
"I'm engaged."
Go around saying that.
Got it?
Can you handle a middle schooler?

messages.ko: 아.. 이제 내가 경찰서 가있으면 되는거야?
messages.en: Ah... so I just have to be at the police station now?
You got engaged to a minor??
I'll turn myself in.
Let's keep it simple and use Ring Pop candy as our couple rings.
That's not it~ ~
Get me a netherite ring.
The strongest one.
Then I'll give you an obsidian necklace.
You can get that just by mining a little stone.

messages.ko: 나 다이아 풀셋 있는데 그건 안될까...?
messages.en: I have a full diamond set though. Wouldn't that work...?
I want netherite!!!!!!
Ah, I'll wear a suit instead.
I changed my mind.
Because I'm too handsome.
Am I handsome?
How is it?
What do you think~?
It's yoursㅋ
Enjoy it.
Ah, am I just cute?
It's yoursㅋ
But if you marry me...
You have to handle Hayeon overdoing things every day.
Handle pretty Hayeon every day.

messages.ko: 매일 많이 먹는 하연 식비 감당하기
messages.en: Handle the food expenses of Hayeon who eats a lot every day.
There's a lot to handle.
You come home and I'm playing two cocoders. Can you handle it?
The upstairs neighbor comes down telling me to stop playing the recorder.
Can you still handle it?
The upstairs neighbor comes down...
I hand the recorder to **y/n** and hide.
Then you get blamed.
Can you handle that?
I'd probably cry because it's so unfair.
Don't cry, baby~
But I'll buy our newlywed house.
Let's get married.
You materialistic person!!!!
I can't live somewhere if I can't see the Han River...
Even if you can't see the Han River, I'll make you Han River ramen.
But even if it's watery Chapagetti, you have to eat it all~❤️
That just means my love is overflowing that much~
In our newlywed house...
Let's make a PC room.
Let's play Roblox. I'll teach you.
I think I'll be better~ ~ ~
Bleh.
Let's play Minecraft. I'll carry you.
I think I'll be better~ ~ ~

messages.ko: 아 몰라!! 그럼 언니가 다 알려줘
messages.en: Ah, whatever!! Then unnie, you teach me everything.
Unnie will go turn herself in first, okay?
You'll come visit me... right?
I'll secretly sneak you a Dubai chewy cookie when I come visit.
Seriously, what's with Dubai chewy cookies being so popular these days?
I used to just buy them near my house.
Now they're sold out everywhere.
They even give you Dubai chewy cookies when you get your blood drawn.
Ah, what? You should've told me earlier.
I got my blood drawn today.
It wasn't a blood donation though~
I'm not sick right nowㅋㅋㅋ
I just feel like I've been getting sick often lately.
As a precaution...?
I got checked.
You can't get sick after we get married either, so please don't get sick.
If I get sick after we get married...
**Y/n** would be my guardian then?
You don't want to go to the hospital every day, do you~?
Then I'd probably get exhausted.
Are you a T?
But honestly, you seem like an F these days.
Seseseririously?
Ah, but I'm 18. Can unnie really be my guardian?
Of course!! I'll be at the police station, so give me a call~
But do you know?
They say people's pinkies are all bent these days.
Because of their phones.
My pinky felt numb, so I looked at it...
It was doing isolation all by itself.

messages.ko: 잘하면 하트도 만들 수 있을 거 같아
messages.en: If you get good at it, I think you could even make a heart.
Even better~ ~
Wow, I should sesese go to sleep now.
Ah, reareally?
Reareally.
ㅋㅎㅎㅋㅎㅋㅋㅎㄹㅋㅋㄹㄹㅋ
I hope today is another happy Hayeon Day❤️
Good night, my fiancé~😉
Haranghae😍
